scope.summary: Implement the visual-inspection-duty harness enforcing that a model MUST inspect BOTH structured output (document-model diffs, receipts, exported-file integrity) AND rendered visual output (canvas/screenshot capture via the foundation StudioRenderHarness MT-008 + Argus) before claiming a Studio edit done, and that proposal receipts carry before/after evidence references. A done-claim without both evidence classes is rejected.
acceptance_criteria: done requires structured + rendered evidence; receipts carry before/after refs; headless fallback
expected_tests: negative: a done-claim missing structured OR rendered evidence is rejected
live: proposal receipt carries before/after render + diff references
test: falls back to AccessKit-tree assertion when headless-GPU readback unreliable

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

target_entries: Studio / Validation / Visual inspection duty (model layer)

risk_if_missed: Models claim edits done without visual proof; regressions ship unseen.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
